protocol: Three single changes of LiveMemory (episodic_lab/r41b_memory.py, v2), each run through the full dev check bench/m3/run_round41b.py and the unit tests tests/test_round41b.py in a fresh copy of the lab, new process with -B.

no_cache_invalidation.change: ingest() keeps the cached results of the affected fact

no_index_update.change: ingest() writes the store but does not add the report to the per-fact index

no_id_check.change: ingest() accepts a report id that already exists

note: All three are caught. Without cache invalidation the instance fails only where a question repeats a query time after new reports: Q3 (200 of 400, the A worlds) and after the restart Q9 / Q10 (all 400); questions at new query times hide it. The missing id check is not exercised by the generated sequences (they never repeat an id) and is caught by the unit test test_duplicate_id_is_refused_without_side_effects.
